cues.en: Dwarf Fortress is one of the most interesting games ever made, but the reason we've been sitting on this interview for so long is that our usual trick of using gameplay b roll to explain what the developer is talking about doesn't really work here.

cues.zh: 奇异、互联的模拟系统，能够产生电子游戏中最狂野的涌现式玩法和叙事。我偶尔玩玩Dwarf Fortress，但主要是看YouTube视频。事实上，为了帮助说明这个游戏的一些运作方式，我们已获得许可，使用我最喜欢的Dwarf Fortress故事讲述者Krugsmash的一些片段。

cues.en: Yeah. So my name is Tarn Adams and I'm the co founder of Bay twelve Games And I'm making a game called Dwarf Fortress with my brother, Zach. The website's been up for eighteen and a half years.
cues.zh: 是的。我叫Tarn Adams，是Bay twelve Games的联合创始人，我和我弟弟Zach正在做一款叫Dwarf Fortress的游戏。网站已经上线十八年半了。

cues.en: Been working on Dwarf Fortress for sixteen of those, the first few on and off, but steady for about fourteen. We'd we'd always been working on a kind of fantasy role playing simulation type game, even when I was like, know, very very young. I remember in elementary school we had a game called Drag Slay.
cues.zh: 其中十六年一直在做Dwarf Fortress，最初几年断断续续，但稳定做了大约十四年。我们一直在做某种奇幻角色扮演模拟类型的游戏，甚至在我非常非常小的时候。我记得小学时我们有个游戏叫Drag Slay。

cues.en: So we hadn't really seen a kind of RPG fantasy type game that really indulged in the same things that like Civilization was doing or whatever, where you could make a whole map or whatever. There was the roguelite games, which of course we were heavily into where they make their own dungeons and so forth. But we were we we just wanted to make a whole world. Why not make the whole world?
